title: DevX signal orchestrator and iteration playbook for SDKs, docs, and quickstarts
creator: Priya Menon
description:
Objective: create a lightweight 'signal orchestrator' and iteration playbook to coordinate experiments across SDKs, docs, and quickstarts. The deliverable is a repeatable cadence (playbook) with tooling hooks that surfaces cohort metrics, qualitative feedback, and experiment outcomes to drive OKR progress.

Success metrics:
- 20% improvement in first-run success for SDK quickstarts (measured by tutorial completion events)
- Reduction in time-to-first-API-call by 30% for sample apps
- Two documented rollouts per cycle using the playbook and signal dashboard

Deliverables:
- Playbook doc (confluence) with checklists, rollout templates, and evaluation rubric
- Signal dashboard (metabase/Grafana) with cohort funnels and hot-path traces
- Lightweight tagging convention for telemetry events
- One pilot experiment across Node SDK quickstarts and docs snippets

Scope exclusions: API changes requiring runtime work or infra provisioning beyond lightweight telemetry adapters.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: finalize playbook, define events & tags
- Week 2: instrument Node quickstarts, create dashboard panels
- Week 3: run pilot with 3 sample apps, collect feedback
- Week 4: iterate & publish playbook; handoff to enablement
